meaning: Sets the default geometry of this element: length l = 10.0 and density ρ = 1.0 in the component's own units, used when a caller does not pass them. Together they scale the ρ·l-type inertial coefficient this element contributes.

could_move.what: Any pressure or flow solved through this component when it is instantiated without explicit l or ρ — amplitude and phase depend on the ρ·l inertance scale.
The single entry point that builds and solves the model; the only place this default can surface.

expectation: Unknown in size. Directionally, larger l or ρ raises the inertial coefficient and slows the transient. The static trace found no references, so the default may never be exercised; I cannot tell from this context whether it is live.

check.why: One solve of the only entry point that reaches this element, far cheaper than a re-fit; outputs can be compared before and after perturbing l.
